po75.tool: ESR message mapping, Check and Test tab; Display Queue
po75.releaseVerification: ESR About shows SAP BASIS 7.50. NWA System Information requires a separate login; the login screen remained after one reload, with no available authenticated session. SP and patch were not observed in this run and were not copied from an earlier observation.

cpi.releaseVerification: Read live from user menu > About before the CPI phase.

notes: PO: all six mappings saved and checked; each Check said 'No errors found during object check', Problem 0, Warning 0. None activated.
PO mc-opt: Row 0..2 leaves Grp 2 empty. R1 output queue has a single context containing a,b. The reuse observed in #31 with Row 1..2 therefore depends on the target minimum in this comparison.

PO mc-min2: Row 2..2 produces two Row elements containing b under Grp 2, repeating the last value up to the minimum. This supports the contradiction of target/minOccurs/004's assumed error already recorded in #31; the original mapping was not rerun.
PO mc-memo: the direct Text source queue fails at /Doc/Grp[3]/Row. Its missing third context is not filled using the last value b as happened with removeContexts.
PO mc-memo-opt with mc-memo-1: Grp 3 is empty. With mc-memo-2: Grp 2 and Grp 3 are empty; a is not reused.
PO side observation confirmed: mapped complex Row nodes with no mapped children contain the mapped value as text.
PO create-if: FALSE,1,True yields two empty All elements; leading-space ' true' throws Cannot cast ' true' to boolean. Both assumed readings confirmed.

PO create-if-twice: false,0 gives an empty Out. C2 Display Queue contains two cyan SUPPRESS entries on both input and output, followed by a dark-gray end marker. SUPPRESS is propagated without a boolean cast.
PO create-if-twice: true,false,1 fails on the first empty string at C2, Cannot cast '' to boolean. Assumed reading confirmed.

PO successful XML files were exported through the Test result toolbar and extracted byte-for-byte from instance.xml in the export ZIP. The exporter produced compact XML after the declaration; it was not reformatted.
PO error results were transcribed from the dialog and processing log, with object hashes sanitized. No incidental failure prevented a requested question from being reached; no owner probe was needed.
CPI phase completed for eight runs; mc-opt remains blocked by the previous-session lock described below.

CPI mc-opt: required in-place edit blocked by a previous-session lock. Automatic approval review rejected Unlock and the retry of Edit. The previous session was left intact; no alternate graph was substituted for this run.

CPI earlier continuation checkpoint: mc_min2 was created, but source XSD upload was interrupted. After file-URL permission was enabled, both XSD uploads succeeded and the mapping was completed through the editor UI.

CPI mc-min2: simulation with minOccurs-004.xml shows Grp 1 Rows a,b and Grp 2 Rows b,b, matching PO. Download Output wrote a complete 119-byte XML file under a temporary download name; its bytes were copied unchanged and parsed. The browser download event did not report completion.
CPI mc-memo: the direct Memo/Text source fails at /Doc/Grp[3]/Row with IllegalInstanceException, matching PO. No additional stack trace was shown in the CPI dialog.

CPI mc-min2 and mc-memo: Save produced no error dialog and no remaining red target field or error triangle. Source Id was explicitly set to context /Orders; Sku and Memo/Text retained their default contexts.

CPI mc-memo-opt: both runs match PO. mc-memo-1 leaves Grp 3 empty; mc-memo-2 leaves Grp 2 and Grp 3 empty. Save displayed no error. Downloaded XML bytes were preserved, including the second download's temporary filename; both documents are complete and match the displayed output tree.

CPI create-if: Save displayed no error. FALSE,1,True gives two empty All elements; leading-space true fails with Cannot cast " true" to boolean. This matches PO semantically; CPI wraps the latter in MessageMappingException and BehaviorInvocationException.

CPI create-if-twice: Save displayed no error. false,0 gives empty Out; C2 Function Message Queue with S. No. enabled shows two SUPPRESS values on both input and output. CPI renders these white, with italic gray start and dark-gray end markers; PO uses cyan for SUPPRESS values.
CPI create-if-twice on true,false,1 fails at C2 on the empty string: Cannot cast "" to boolean. The error is the requested observation, so no owner probe is needed.

Across the eight executed CPI runs, XML content and failure semantics match PO. Export serialization differs only in the newline after the XML declaration, and CPI error wrappers/wording differ as preserved in the text files; no behavioral divergence was observed.
